title: Pause menu Resume button covered and not clickable
observed: When paused at tick 21, the btn-resume button reports top=false, so something else (the 'Key collected' toast is still on screen) sits on top of it and a click would not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable with nothing covering it, so Resume must be the topmost element at its centre while the pause menu is open.

title: Restart leaves the game paused with no dialog, so input is stuck
observed: After pause then click btn-restart, the state stays mode=paused with no pause dialog or button shown in the UI list. Waiting does nothing and the state is frozen for 30+ ticks.
expected: Restart puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so mode should be playing and the player can act.

title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after a coin is collected
observed: After dash-down+use, the state reports coins=1 and the coin was collected (score 100), but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'.
expected: The HUD always shows the current values, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Spike damage underflows the score into large positive and negative values
observed: Score was 100 when spikes hit. Instead of flooring at 0, the score became 65136 (a 16-bit wraparound of 100-500), and later went to -300 after a coin, which violates the 0 to 999,999 range.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so it should be 0 after the spike, and it must always stay within 0 to 999,999.

title: Two movement keys in one tick move the player 3 tiles (down then dash-down)
observed: Tick 0 with tokens down+dash-down moved the player from (1,1) to (1,4), a 3-tile displacement. The earlier 'down' step was applied in addition to the dash.
expected: Only the last movement key counts (dash-down), so the player makes at most one move (a dash of up to 2 tiles). Expected position is (1,3).

title: Input after pause in the same tick still moves the player
observed: Tokens pause+right paused the game, but the player moved from (1,1) to (2,1) in that tick (events: pause, move).
expected: When the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves. The player should stay at (1,1).

title: Level-complete Finish button is covered by the bonus banner
observed: After completing the level, the Finish button (btn-next) is visible but top=false, meaning another element (the 'Time bonus' banner) sits on top of its centre, so clicks do not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it. Finish should receive clicks on the level-complete dialog.

title: HUD Coins counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5', and it remains stale when paused.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: HUD Coins counter lags behind the coin count (same symptom as HUD coins mismatch)
observed: After dash-down+use collected a coin, state coins=1 but HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD catches up only later (1/5 at tick 18), so it lags the real count.
expected: The HUD shows the current coin count at all times, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' immediately after the coin is collected. This is the same underlying HUD desync as candidate 9.
